name: hcapp_setBulkEventAttendence
description: Sets attendance for many hashers at one event in a single call. @hasherIds is a comma-separated list of hasher UUIDs, parsed with STRING_SPLIT + TRY_CAST (tokens that are not UUIDs are dropped silently). Existing HasherEventMap rows for the event are updated (AttendenceState, RsvpState = 3); hashers with no row get one inserted (IsHare 0, VirginVisitorType 0, RsvpState 3). Only states 20-40 (on trail or On Inn) are accepted — bulk un-attend is not supported. After the commit, run counts are recalculated for every user whose HEM row changed (HC6.nonApi_updateRunCountsForAllUsers), then the SP delegates to HC6.hcapp_syncEventAdminData and streams its rowsets. Auth: device-bound token via HC6.ValidateAppAuth (spNumber 25, @param NULL). Permission gate: HC6.CheckKennelPermission 'manageAttendance' in the event's kennel, satisfied also by being a hare of this event (IsHare = 1 on the caller's own HEM row); refused with 1325/13.

parameters.name: deviceId
parameters.description: Registered device UUID, passed to HC6.ValidateAppAuth. No SQL default.

parameters.name: accessToken
parameters.description: Short-lived token validated against the device secret. No SQL default.

parameters.name: eventId
parameters.description: Event to update. NULL or the zero UUID is refused with 1225/12. No SQL default.

parameters.name: hasherIds
parameters.description: Comma-separated hasher UUIDs (HasherEventMap.UserId values). NULL is refused with 1225/12; an empty string or a list of unparseable tokens succeeds with '0 records updated, 0 records inserted'. No SQL default.

parameters.name: attendenceState
parameters.description: State applied to every listed hasher. Must be 20-40 inclusive; NULL or out of range is refused with 1225/12. No SQL default.

parameters.name: hasherEventMapUpdatedAfter
parameters.description: Sync watermark passed to hcapp_syncEventAdminData; NULL is coerced to 'ignore' before delegation. No SQL default — omitting it is an unlogged 500.

parameters.name: hasherKennelMapUpdatedAfter
parameters.description: Sync watermark passed to hcapp_syncEventAdminData; NULL is coerced to 'ignore' before delegation. No SQL default — omitting it is an unlogged 500.

rowsets.name: WriteEnvelope
rowsets.description: Always the first rowset. success = 0 on auth, validation, permission or CATCH failure with errorCode/errorType set; success = 1 after the commit with both NULL.

columns.name: errorCode
columns.description: ValidateAppAuth code; 1225 validation (eventId, attendenceState, hasherIds); 1325 not authorised; 1925 unhandled. NULL on success.

columns.name: errorType
columns.description: 1/3/7 from ValidateAppAuth; 12 validation; 13 not authorised; 19 unhandled (CATCH). NULL on success.

rowsets.name: ErrorDetail
rowsets.description: Rowset 1 on failure only. The HC6 app error detail; every failure path writes HC.ErrorLog (the permission refusal rolls back FIRST, then logs, so the row survives).

rowsets.name: BulkAttendanceResult
rowsets.description: Rowset 1 on success. One row summarising how many HEM rows were updated and inserted.

rowsets.name: SyncEventAdminData (delegated)
rowsets.description: Rowsets 2+ on success: the full response of HC6.hcapp_syncEventAdminData for @eventId with the two HEM/HKM watermarks passed through and hashers, narrow events, payments, kennel credits and receipts 'ignore'. See that SP's contract.

sideEffects: UPDATE HC.HasherEventMap SET AttendenceState = @attendenceState, RsvpState = 3, updatedAt = GETDATE() for each parsed UUID that already has a row on the event (lines 153-164).
INSERT HC.HasherEventMap (IsHare 0, VirginVisitorType 0, RsvpState 3, KennelId from HC.Event) for each parsed UUID without a row (lines 169-182).
EXEC HC6.nonApi_updateRunCountsForAllUsers @updatedSince = one second before the write — after COMMIT, outside the transaction (line 189).
INSERT HC.ErrorLog on every refusal and in the CATCH (HcVersion from HC6.DeviceHcVersion(@deviceId)).

codeSmells.detail: Lines 3-9: none of the seven parameters has a SQL default. A client that omits one — the two sync watermarks are the likely ones — gets 'expects parameter @x, which was not supplied' before the procedure runs: an empty 500 with no HC.ErrorLog row, and the body's own NULL checks never run. Give each a default (= NULL) and keep the checks.

codeSmells.issue: Invalid UUIDs in @hasherIds are silently skipped
codeSmells.detail: Lines 153-157 and 169-173: STRING_SPLIT + TRY_CAST drops any token that is not a UUID without telling the caller. A malformed list partially succeeds; the only clue is the counts in serverMessage.

codeSmells.issue: Comma delimiter on a list parameter
codeSmells.detail: Line 155/171: the list is split on ','. The house rule is '|' for delimited parameters. Harmless here because a UUID cannot contain a comma, but the SP cannot be switched without changing the app at the same time.

codeSmells.issue: Run-count recalculation runs after the commit
codeSmells.detail: Line 189: nonApi_updateRunCountsForAllUsers is deliberately outside the transaction. If it fails, the attendance is committed but the counts are stale until the next recalculation — and the failure surfaces as a raw error after the envelope has NOT yet been sent (the SELECTs at 191-196 follow it inside the TRY, so the CATCH does report it as 1925).

codeSmells.issue: Unknown event is reported as an unhandled error
codeSmells.detail: Line 128: an @eventId with no HC.Event row leaves @kennelId NULL; CheckKennelPermission then denies (1325) or, for a hare, the INSERT at 174 fails on KennelId NOT NULL and is reported as 1925/19 rather than a 'no such event' validation error.

breakingChanges: @hasherIds widened from VARCHAR(8000) to NVARCHAR(MAX) — callers passing exactly 8000 characters are unaffected; callers relying on implicit truncation at 8000 characters will now receive the full string
TRY/CATCH and BEGIN TRANSACTION added — the entire UPDATE+INSERT is now atomic; HC5 had no transaction so partial writes were possible
Success envelope (rowset 0: success, errorCode, errorType) added as the new first rowset — HC5 had no envelope; all HC5 rowset indices shift up by one
Delegation target updated from HC5.hcapp_syncEventAdminData to HC6.hcapp_syncEventAdminData — sync rowset columns may differ
serverMessage trailing comma removed — HC5 produced 'N records updated, M records inserted, ' (trailing comma); HC6 produces 'N records updated, M records inserted'
Permission gate moved to HC6.CheckKennelPermission 'manageAttendance' (hare of the event also allowed) — refused with 1325/13
